caption: The drawing depicts a rounded ceramic jug with a thick handle arching from one side of the neck to the other. The jug is colored in muted beige tones with some reddish-brown and gray shading, creating an impression of texture and wear. A cobalt blue floral or leaf motif is painted on the front of the jug below the neck and around the spout base. The spout itself is short and cylindrical with a dark brown, almost black, opening. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, angled depiction of the same jug, showing its shape and paint from a different viewpoint. The composition is simple, with the larger jug occupying most of the frame and outlined by a faint rectangular border on a cream-colored background. Handwritten text appears at the lower left and engraved lines appear at the lower right outside the outlined border.
title: Harvester Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
